name: chuchula-functions
description: Server-authoritative Chuchula online play: rules engine, rooms and bots.

scripts.test:rules: npm run build && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-chuchula --config ../firebase.json "node --test lib/rules-test/*.test.js"
scripts.serve: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --only functions,firestore,auth --project demo-chuchula
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && firebase emulators:exec --only functions,firestore,auth --project demo-chuchula --config ../firebase.json "node --test lib/e2e-test/*.test.js"
